source_title: Transforming Data Into Actionable Insights in the Lab
source_excerpt:
SAN DIEGO , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- QuidelOrtho Corporation (Nasdaq: QDEL ), a leading global provider of diagnostic solutions, has released episode 62 of its Science Bytes podcast, exploring best practices in AI and informatics to make lab operations smoother.
Laboratories are facing increasing complexity and growing testing demand. Historically, data across the lab has existed in silos. Labs need ways to integrate this data and accelerate clinical decision-making. Informatics serves as a critical means to drive efficiency, performance and data accuracy â having a real impact on patients awaiting test results.
Hosted by Josh Casey, this episode features QuidelOrtho's Vice President of Software Engineering for Global Informatics Platforms, Rodney Guzman, who illustrates how to apply structured informatics to transform results from discrete laboratory systems into meaningful clinical knowledge.
Clinical laboratories face workforce challenges, including shortages of specialists to manage complex testing scenarios
AI has the potential to optimize test utilization, eliminate redundant testing and reduce workflow bottlenecks
However, before this happens, the underlying lab data must be standardized, reliable and traceable; otherwise, the AI system can't deliver reliable insights
Informatics serves as a means to consolidate, organize and present data sets consistently
Integrating this data is particularly beneficial for supporting applications like transfusion medicine where a complex array of data influences clinical decisions
In any lab setting, AI augments clinical experts, and lab professionals are ultimately responsible for interpreting results and making final decisions
Listen to the latest episode of the QuidelOrtho Science Bytes podcast on major streaming platforms or at https://www.quidelortho.com/global/en/resources/podcasts/Episode-62-Turning-results-into-answers .
